reviews.title: The app & customer service have been 5*!!
reviews.contents: I have had a difficult weaning journey with multiples allergies which have been terrifying but the app is such an amazing tool that has helped me track each individual food item I give my son and I have used this as my report for the allergy clinic but also for my own personal reference whilst I slowly introduce all the foods to him. Not only has it been huge for his allergies, the guidance and support has really helped me and the amount of available information in an easy to read format is so useful and the videos! I have found since becoming a mum that almost every app or website can quickly become overwhelming but this app has been the only source I can really rely on through this - I have also had to contact customer service a couple of times now and they have responded within hours and gone the extra mile to help. I never usually write reviews but this app truly deserves the recognition and people deserve to have such a useful tool on their phone!

reviews.title: Gone downhill
reviews.contents:
I used this with my first son and raved about the app and website to all other parents I knew. Was excited to get started with my new son and even though the price had gone up enormously I still felt it was worth it as especially the first foods I find so useful in the past. However things started badly and got worse. 
 
Logged in and got my latest sons profile set up and offered me a free trial however then took me to the page which ended up charging me immediately anyway so not sure what happened there but fine I though I’m going to use it anyway so whatever. Then couldn’t access any of the guides I’d been charged for. Couldn’t log any foods. Couldn’t add anything to my first foods. Kept getting error messages. Followed the troubleshooting and now can’t log back in as even the forgot password is giving error messages. Was using the app free features fine for a month (in the run up to 6m and weaning) as soon as I pay everything stopped working. TBH I’m not sure the new features warrant the high subscription cost yes there’s lots of different features now but are these things we want/need? I’m not convinced. Perhaps they could have had a scaled model or specific packages like they used to where you could ad hoc purchase certain guides. Sadly have cancelled my subscription and now going with another weaning guide which is better value.

reviews.title: Useful but restrictive
reviews.contents: I was recommended this app and I can understand why as the database is useful for beginning baby led weaning; however there are a couple of issues that would be helpful to know when subscribing. Firstly, to access the allergen introductory meals you need to unlock them one by one which makes shopping and planning for feeding impossible as you have to log the meal as done to see what you need for the following day, this does not make for a sensible way of operating with a baby as you may not have the suggested items to serve unless you are up for daily shopping. You can somewhat work round this by marking the meals as done but then it automatically logs each ingredient which you have to individually remove if you have not tried them with your baby yet. I also found the suggested meals assumed you had already served other recipes that hadn’t been suggested which meant hopping between meals for preparation guidance and, again, made planning tricky. All in all a useful tool but the free part would be sufficient  if you don’t want to follow the suggested day by day plan or waste time deleting logs to access meals.

reviews.title: Needs a more user friendly way to track
reviews.contents: Great app for info about what/how to serve at what age but not user friendly for tracking. For many reasons… For instance, you can’t use characters like “/“ in the notes which makes it hard to use as you can’t write 1/2 pear - only letters. Tracking is not very intuitive, in my opinion they need to hire a UX expert. It’s a bit cumbersome to add foods to several days. Adding multiple foods to a day is also time consuming. I can never quite understand where I am in the app, especially in the food log section. I just don’t have the time. Also I expected to have the guides they offer as PDFs in this app, not have to buy them separately. I’d be willing to pay more but just have them there. Another issue is missing common foods like egg yolks but only having eggs. I don’t want to have to add something as basic as this manually. Personally I’m slightly disappointed that this app recommends Cheerios to 9+ months old babies. Featured food? Why?! A way to build bad eating habits and metabolic health issues. Sugar and processed foods have no place in a baby’s diet. Everyone’s choice but don’t push it.

reviews.title: This became my BLW Bible.
reviews.contents:
I’m not one to heavily rely on one thing. But this became my one stop shop for everything BLW. It provided me with the guidance I needed to help my baby join us at the table. It provided me with the confidence to stand my ground with my approach using medical professional advice and information. And it helped me and my baby form a wonderful relationship with our meal times. I learnt how capable he was and it was such a gift to be able to trust him and have him be independent, watching him enjoy his meals. 

It definitely helped to navigate those trickier parts of mealtimes in a way that was constructive, and gave me useful tips on keeping baby engaged at meal times. 

We have such a wonderful little eater and o look forward to watching him navigate the toddler years with the same curiosity and interest in learning about new foods.

reviews.title: Very expensive now
reviews.contents:
Used this with my first child just over 2 years ago and it cost maybe £5-6 a month? It was invaluable then, especially as a first time mother. My youngest has started weaning and I just wanted to remind myself of how to serve some things and track what foods he’s tried but it’s more than 10x the price!! And whilst the “how to serve” function is free, the app is so paywalled that you can’t even search a food without it popping up several times asking about subscribing. I also can’t seem to find an easy way to track the food without it doing the same despite that supposedly being free. I can see there’s a lot more guidance and guides etc now which is probably fantastic advice for new mums and I can see why it justifies the price (sort of!) however it feels remiss to not have different layers of membership for those of us not actually needing that! Or at the very least not having the annoying pop up to get you to subscribe every time you try to search for a food! 

Safe to say I won’t be using it this time.

reviews.title: Disappointing upgrade
reviews.contents:
I paid for the subscription with the app due to the 100 day introduction to solids compass week by week meal plan. I was a couple of weeks in when the app upgraded and the interface of the app became much less user friendly and the week by week guide is no longer available so I have had to purchase the plan separately on their website.
I contacted the help email address to ask for a refund of my subscription as this was the only reason I subscribed. I have not received a response. I have cancelled my subscription. I think the change to the app was short sighted as many people will subscribe for this feature. Just having recipes and a much less clearer compass plan is not enough of a draw to keep subscribing when there are cheaper weaning apps with recipes. You now have to chose which recipes to introduce from the app. The whole point was that I wanted a clear directed plan. The PDF version of the weaning guide from the website is also much less user friendly.

reviews.title: Extremely Helpful for Weaning
reviews.contents:
This app has given me so much confidence with introducing my baby to so many different foods. I can quickly search for a type of food and immediately get a tonne of information about it. The pictures of how to serve are brilliant, the other thing I’ve found really useful is the videos of children eating the food - it’s such a confidence booster knowing what to expect. 
The only tiny thing I would suggest for improvement is sometimes it just says ‘cook’ the food, and I would like to know what way to cook! Do I roast/steam? etc. 
I felt all at sea when I started the weaning process and although I’m still learning and muddling through, I would have struggled so much without this app so thank you.

reviews.title: Fantastic resources
reviews.contents: I’m so pleased I found Solid Starts. I started to follow them on Instagram, bought the Starting Solids bundle and use the app. The bundle is great value for money as you get so much information and excellent resources which have massively helped me with weaning. I was anxious after having a fussy toddler but Solid Starts really gave me confidence when I was in doubt. The food database in the app is brilliant and I use it all the time to check at what age certain foods can be introduced and how they should be served. I only wish I could access the the starting solids bundle info via the app (which wasn’t an option when I bought the bundle) - the subscription looks great.

reviews.title: Don’t fall for ‘free’ trial
reviews.contents: I downloaded this app after hearing lots of positive reviews and signed up for the seven day trial with a view to potentially keeping the subscription for maybe a couple of months if it proved useful. I’m on day seven which should be the last day of my free trial and I’ve already been charged for an entire year. Why not call it a six day trial if that’s what you’re actually offering? Seems like they’re trying to catch people out. I can’t afford £99 and now I’m in financial trouble just for trying to care for my baby. Absolutely disgusting. If anyone is thinking of trying this, cancel your subscription IMMEDIATELY to make sure they can’t scam you too. Or better yet, stick with the free version. App seems fine other than that. It’s basically just a list of foods you can select when baby has tried them.
